experiment: Recipient-level household model: E0 kappa profile, E1 (beta = 0), E2 map, distribution
receipt: s(A_c, A_k) + kappa [A_c + A_k > 0] (s(N_c, N_k) - s(A_c, A_k)), s = expit(b0 + b_any [a>0] + b_c log(1+a) + b_k log(1+b) + eta need + beta S_t); kappa = replacement share in [0, 1]

kappa_free.note: kappa in [0, 1]: maximum of the profile on the grid

criterion: quarterly log RMSE 2020Q2..2021Q4, receipt index (COVID / no-COVID) vs Banxico / 2017-19 trend
count_mapping: transfers per receiving household constant (Banxico index = receiving-household index)
likelihood: Gaussian on quarterly log residuals 2020Q2..2021Q4, SD = 2017-19 quarterly trend residual SD (0.0143); 7 autocorrelated quarters, use ratios only
